old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ffim","title":"Reconcile an Announce floor committed before gradient admission fails","description":"P1 correctness: AnnounceProcessor.process() durably advances state_committer before GradientTable.update(). If the gradient update raises after the durable commit, in-memory pin/seen/route state stays empty but the stored sequence floor advances. Retrying the same authenticated Announce is then rejected as STALE_SEQNUM after restart, so the route and peer admission cannot be reconstructed. This violates the intended atomic admission contract.
